PreToolUse.hook: FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '(parent/pom\.xml|screwdriver\.yaml)$'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Cannot modify parent/pom.xml or screwdriver.yaml without explicit approval' && exit 2; fi

CMD="$CLAUDE_BASH_COMMAND"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^mvn\s' && ! echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '\-pl\s'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Root-level mvn build without -pl flag. Use: mvn <goal> -pl <module>' && exit 2; fi

PostToolUse.hook: echo "[trace] Bash command completed with exit code $CLAUDE_EXIT_CODE"
